food.// alwaysEdible: Whether this mod's foods can be eaten on a full hunger bar, the way a golden apple can. On by default, because otherwise none of them can be eaten in creative at all. Off restores vanilla's rule.

dishes.// dishEffects: Whether the exotic dishes apply their status effects at all. Turn this off on a server where the buffs are too strong; the dishes still feed you.
dishes.// dishDrawbacks: Whether the exotic dishes apply their DOWNSIDES. On by default, because the downside is what the buff is paid for; turning it off is a cheat switch.

butchery.// extraMeatDrops: Whether animals that Alex's Mobs gives no meat drop of their own should drop a raw cut when killed. Turn this off to leave every vanilla loot table alone.
butchery.// extraMeatDropChance: Chance for one of those animals to drop its cut, from 0 (never) to 1 (always).
butchery.// extraMeatDropMax: Largest number of cuts one of those animals can drop. The actual count is a roll between one and this, scaled down for the smaller animals.
